# Fieldnotes

> An independent community library of AI engineering resources whose first collection is HuaShu's AI Orange Books.

The text of a book is in this library only when the book has a "Mirrored book" section below, and each of those books carries its author's own license. Every other book is cataloged with a link to the author's official source. Resolve an id to its record and citation with `python3 scripts/resolve.py <id>`, and check the citations of a document with `python3 scripts/check_citations.py <file>`.

## Agent instructions

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): How to search this library, read a chapter, quote it, and cite it.

## Books that are not mirrored

These books are cataloged with their license evidence. Read them at the author's official source, and do not quote them from this library.

- [OpenAI Codex: The Complete Guide](https://www.huasheng.ai/orange-books/codex/): `codex-orange-book`, reference-only, license CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Original title: OpenAI Codex 从入门到精通. Its text is not in this library.
- [Claude Code: The Complete Guide](https://www.huasheng.ai/orange-books/claude-code/): `claude-code-orange-book`, reference-only, license CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Original title: Claude Code 从入门到精通. Its text is not in this library.

- [3D Vibe Coding Handbook](https://www.huasheng.ai/orange-books/3d-vibe-coding/): `3d-vibe-coding-handbook`, reference-only, license CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Original title: 3D Vibe Coding 手册. The English title is this library's translation. Its text is not in this library.
- [Harness Engineering: The Complete Guide](https://www.huasheng.ai/orange-books/harness/): `harness-engineering-orange-book`, reference-only, informal terms that name no SPDX license. Original title: Harness Engineering：缰绳工程学完全指南. Its text is not in this library.

## Indexes

- [index/catalog.json](index/catalog.json): Every book with its license id, mirror status, quote-permitted flag, editions, and official URLs.
- [index/chapters.jsonl](index/chapters.jsonl): One JSON object per line for each mirrored chapter, with its id, path, source pages, and errata.
- [index/topics.json](index/topics.json): Every topic with the books and chapters it references.
